B0103/12 Short in D Squib Circuit (to B+) DTC
CIRCUIT DESCRIPTION
The D squib circuit consists of the airbag sensor assembly, spiral cable and steering wheel pad.
It causes the SAS to deploy when the SAS deployment conditions are satisfied.
For details of the function of each component, see OPERATION on page RS-2.
OTC 80103/12 is recorded when a B+ short is detected in the D squib circuit.
